meta.curation: Standalone, new, exact-variant listings only. Bundles, accessories, refurbished, marketplace and color-variant-mismatched listings were excluded (see excluded_traps). Catalog results carry no UPC, so every offer here is title-matched only and must stay in the 'suspected' table until a source returns a real identifier. Shipping and tax are not in catalog data and stay unknown/zero. Stock is not asserted by this snapshot; verify at the merchant page before buying. Prices older than 24h are stale per PLAN.md.
